name: Brightness
author: João Pereira
description: Ambient-light auto brightness for your screens and keyboard: the Apple Studio Display, a laptop panel or a DDC/CI monitor, and the keyboard backlight, from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Brightness sliders for the display this bar is on and, on the laptop's bar, the keyboard, each with an Auto mode driven by an ambient light sensor; manual only without one. Shows only on displays the plugin drives.

schema.label: Adjust brightness automatically on newly connected displays
